cost_caveats: Generic frames increase 424 to 2432 bytes and 264 to 2240 bytes. Observable matrix ownership preserves additional intermediate stores/reloads; this is a material generated-code change requiring timing validation.
Symbol spans include alignment padding and static RSP-memory instruction counts are not dynamic traffic or cycle counts. Pointer LEA instructions are included in RSP-memory counts.
Packed frame increases 1920 to 2112 bytes relative to the original baseline; this revision leaves the already aligned packed source unchanged.
Only these three frozen instantiated kernels were verified. This is not a portable compiler guarantee for future builds, nor a claim that every spill is 64-byte aligned.
Representation sizeof expectations were not independently verified: no additional build/runtime probe was performed.
No benchmark, build, test, production edit, or timing acceptance was performed in this review.
